b.203f5bcb66:
<h>Hymnus</h>
<c>E</c>xsúltet cælum láudibus,
Resúltet terra gáudiis:
Apostolórum glóriam
Sacra canunt solémnia.

<h>V</h>os sæcli justi júdices,
Et vera mundi lúmina,
Votis precámur córdium,
Audíte preces súpplicum.

<h>Q</h>ui cælum verbo cláuditis,
Serásque ejus sólvitis:
Nos a peccátis ómnibus
Sólvite jussu, quǽsumus.

<h>Q</h>uorum præcépto súbditur,
Salus, et languor ómnium:
Sanáte ægros móribus,
Nos reddéntes virtútibus.

<h>U</h>t, cum Judex advénerit
Christus in fine sǽculi,
Nos sempitérni gáudii
Fáciat esse cómpotes.

<h>D</h>eo Patri sit glória,
Ejúsque soli Fílio,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Et nunc, et in perpétuum.
Amen.
b.d19229cdde:
<h>Hymn</h>
<c>N</c>ow let the earth with joy resound,
And heaven the chant re-echo round;
Nor heaven nor earth too high can raise
The great Apostles' glorious praise.

<h>O</h> ye who, throned in glory dread,
Shall judge the living and the dead,
Lights of the world forevermore!
To you the suppliant prayer we pour.

<h>Y</h>e close the sacred gates on high;
At your command apart they fly:
Oh! loose for us the guilty chain
We strive to break, and strive in vain.

<h>S</h>ickness and health your voice obey;
At your command they go or stay:
From sin's disease our souls restore;
In good confirm us more and more.

<h>S</h>o when the world is at its end,
And Christ to judgement shall descend,
May we be called those joys to see
Prepared from all eternity.

<h>P</h>raise to the Father, with the Son,
And Holy Spirit, Three in One;
As ever was in ages past,
And so shall be while ages last.
Amen.

<h>Lectio 1</h>
Incipit Epístola prima beáti Joánnis Apóstoli
<r>1 Joannes 1:1-3</r>
<n>1</n> Quod fuit ab inítio, quod audívimus, quod vídimus óculis nostris, quod perspéximus, et manus nostræ contrectavérunt de verbo vitæ:
<n>2</n> Et vita manifestáta est, et vídimus, et testámur, et annuntiámus vobis vitam ætérnam, quæ erat apud Patrem, et appáruit nobis:
<n>3</n> Quod vídimus, et audívimus, annuntiámus vobis, ut et vos societátem habeátis nobíscum, et socíetas nostra sit cum Patre et cum Fílio ejus Jesu Christo.

<r>1 John 1:1-3</r>
<n>1</n> That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the word of life:
<n>2</n> For the life was manifested; and we have seen and do bear witness, and declare unto you the life eternal, which was with the Father, and hath appeared to us:
<n>3</n> That which we have seen and have heard, we declare unto you, that you also may have fellowship with us, and our fellowship may be with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
<r>℣.</r> But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.

<r>℟.</r> Right worthy of honour is the blessed Apostle John, who leaned on the Lord's bosom at the Last Supper.
* To Him did Christ upon the Cross commit His mother, virgin to virgin.
